parts.name: body shell

physics.Basic_description: The main handle and fixed jaw of the wrench, appearing as a long, light grey metallic bar with a ring at one end and a head at the other.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the structural backbone and leverage for the tool, housing the track for the movable jaw.
physics.Grasped_description: A robot gripper would grasp the mid-section of the handle to apply torque or lift the tool.
physics.reason: Hand tools like wrenches are typically forged from solid steel to withstand high torque without bending.

parts.name: jaw shell

physics.Basic_description: A smaller metallic block located at the head of the wrench, designed to slide along the track.
physics.Functional_description: Moves linearly to adjust the width of the wrench opening to fit different nut sizes.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and integrated to be a primary grasp point; usually manipulated indirectly via the screw.
physics.reason: Must be solid metal to resist crushing forces when tightening bolts.

parts.name: worm wheel

physics.Basic_description: A small, knurled cylindrical wheel situated on the side of the wrench head.
physics.Functional_description: Rotates to drive the threaded mechanism that moves the adjustable jaw.
physics.Grasped_description: A gripper could pinch this wheel to rotate it and adjust the jaw width.
physics.reason: Small mechanical components like screws and wheels are machined from solid stock.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
